page_title: MNT 1-4 PSG | Montpellier v PSG 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+1' That's all for today as the game is over.
88' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar.
87' The linesman points to the corner flag, Montpellier are going to take it.

87' Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Arnau Tenas easily deals with the threat. Corner kick. Montpellier will have an opportunity.
85' Here's the change. Joris Chotard leaves the pitch and Teji Savanier (Montpellier) comes on as a substitute.
84' Zoumana Camara prepares a substitution. Theo Chennahi is replaced by Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier).
84' That's the end of the game for Rabby Nzingoula, who is replaced by Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier).
79' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.

78' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the middle of the goal, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Benjamin Lecomte.
76' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier), whose low effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
75' Axel Tape (PSG) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
71' Kang-In Lee (PSG) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
68' Substitution. Yoram Zague (PSG) on for Bradley Barcola.
68' Substitution. Jordan Ferri did his best and is replaced by Junior Ndiaye (Montpellier).
67' Zoumana Camara has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Wilfried Ndollo Bille (Montpellier) replacing Enzo Tchato.

65' 1 - 4 A good lofted pass from Arnau Tenas finds Goncalo Ramos (PSG) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which bounces off the bar and ends up in the back of the net. The score is now 1:4.

64' 1 - 3 An amazing individual effort from Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the left side of the goal and makes it 1:3. Arnau Tenas was helpless.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noham Kamara (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Desire Doue can be given a rest.
59' 0 - 3 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) puts the penalty low into the middle of the goal and past Benjamin Lecomte.
59' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
58' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mathieu Vernice blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for PSG.
57' PSG win a corner.
54' Kang-In Lee (PSG) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
53' Desire Doue (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Ibrahim Mbaye plays it to Goncalo Ramos (PSG), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Benjamin Lecomte. 0:2.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Mathieu Vernice has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' Theo Chennahi (Montpellier) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. Montpellier will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45+1' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Warren Zaire-Emery slips it to Senny Mayulu (PSG) on the edge of the box and he finds the top left corner with a great effort. The score is 0:1.
42' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
40' The free kick from close range, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
39' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is able to continue to play.
38' The game is interrupted now, Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Kang-In Lee (PSG) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
33' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) probably handled the ball.

32' OFF THE BAR! Bradley Barcola (PSG) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
31' Bradley Barcola (PSG) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch.
30' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
30' Montpellier quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
29' Axel Tape (PSG) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mathieu Vernice blows for a foul.
27' Senny Mayulu (PSG) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
26' Montpellier work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
25' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
24' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Benjamin Lecomte easily deals with the threat.
24' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
22' Desire Doue (PSG) commits a rough foul. Mathieu Vernice stops the game and makes a call.
18' The resulting corner from Desire Doue (PSG) is cleared.
17' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Arnau Tenas comes off the line to clear the ball away.
16' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Kang-In Lee (PSG), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
13' Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
11' A quickly taken corner by Montpellier.
11' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.
10' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
6' Arnau Tenas makes a miraculous save! Joris Chotard (Montpellier) gets to a rebound and attempts to put it into the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops his effort.

5' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Arnau Tenas shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
1' The match has just started.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Mathieu Vernice.
